name: Chickpea Flour Dessert (Mysore Pak)
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Roast the g flour in a small amount of ghee.
Combine the sugar, cardamom, and a splash of water in a saucepan. Boil it until the syrup reaches the single thread stage. If more than one thread can be drawn, then more water needs to be added.
Mix half the roasted g flour into the hot sugar syrup, keeping the heat on.
Gradually stir half the ghee into the g flour mixture. Keep stirring the mixture until the ghee is absorbed.
Repeat with the remaining g flour and ghee. More ghee can be added just until the mixture stops taking in more ghee.
After the mixture is boiled, it turns into crispy, bubble form. Pour it in a pan, and let cool.
Cut it into pieces of desired shapes.

culture.text: A dessert is a dish that consists of sweet foods, such as cake, biscuit, ice cream, and possibly a beverage, such as dessert wine or liqueur. Some cultures sweeten foods that are more commonly savory to create desserts. Desserts commonly conclude a meal as a course in many restaurants, while in some parts of the world, there is no tradition of a dessert course to conclude a meal.
